hemomancy.court.lesson.already_taught.about: a system message that the player already knows the Lightkeeper's lesson

hemomancy.court.lesson.refused_degree.about: a system message that the Garden teaches nothing before the fifth Degree

hemomancy.court.lesson.refused_shunned.about: a system message that the Garden will not teach someone scrubbed clean of partners

hemomancy.court.lesson.refused_transgres.about: a system message that the Garden teaches nothing while the player's wrong against it stands

hemomancy.court.lesson.taught.about: a system message that a strain fed in its own house's waters grows faster and the player now knows it

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.amends.line1.about: the Lightkeeper thanking the player for their offering, saying it is on the table with everyone's and the Garden is open to them again

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.directions.l.about: the Lightkeeper naming the houses by depth: Holding Stone on the shore, Shared Wake in open water, Woven Current in the twilight
the Lightkeeper naming the deepest houses, Veiled Fold, Still Bell, Last Marrow and Kindling, and noting each house feeds its own strain best

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.food.line1.about: the Lightkeeper telling the guest to eat first because a lesson is wasted on an empty stomach

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.known.about: the Lightkeeper saying the player found the Garden without a guide, which already tells them something, and inviting them to sit so they can learn what the player came for

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.member.about: the Lightkeeper welcoming a Giving Light member home, saying the lamp is lit and the beds tended, and asking if they need anything

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.greet.referr.about: the Lightkeeper saying that whoever sent the guest knew the Court begins at the Garden and that the first lesson is the Lightkeeper's to give

the Lightkeeper explaining that Sunburst is the Giving Light's own strain, a fungus and alga living as one, which feeds its carrier in the sun
the Lightkeeper explaining that Sunburst fed in the Garden's water after the first lesson grows faster because it is home water

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.early.about: the Lightkeeper explaining the Court takes no one into a house before the fifth Degree and telling the player to return then and ask again

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.line1.about: the Lightkeeper welcoming the player into the Giving Light, promising a place at the table and a share of the work because that is what a house is

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.settled.about: the Lightkeeper sorrowfully telling the player they already used the single permitted move between houses and cannot join the Giving Light

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.join.standin.about: the Lightkeeper saying the Garden barely knows the guest yet, and telling them to spend time there and let the house know them before asking to join

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.early.about: the Lightkeeper telling the guest the first lesson waits for the fifth Degree, and that until then they are welcome to eat and rest without hurry

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.known.about: the Lightkeeper reminding the player they already had the first lesson and telling them to take their strain home to its own house's water

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.line1.about: the Lightkeeper teaching the first lesson: a strain fed inside its own house's water grows faster than anywhere else

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.lesson.line2.about: the Lightkeeper saying the player's Morphling is a partner that wants its home water and answers when fed there, and asking if they see why it is called partnership

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.shunned.line.about: the Lightkeeper apologizing that the player is clean of every partner the Garden lives with, and whatever did that could take the Garden's strains too
the Lightkeeper saying she cannot teach or feed the shunned guest, asking them to keep from the beds and go in peace

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.strain.other.about: the Lightkeeper telling the guest their strain belongs to another house, so the lesson holds for it but only in its own house's water, not the Garden's

hemomancy.court.lightkeeper.strain.own.about: the Lightkeeper noting the player carries Sunburst, that it will grow faster in this water once they have had the lesson, and telling them to ask for it

hemomancy.court.linesman.custom.line1.about: the Linesman accepting a gift of line for the camp, saying it will hold a pod if the water pulls tonight

hemomancy.court.linesman.directions.line.about: the Linesman saying the Shared Wake, Holding Stone and Giving Light lie above the camp, and advising the player to follow the light if going up
the Linesman saying the Veiled Fold and the Still Bell lie below, and advising a slow descent because the light ends at the camp

hemomancy.court.linesman.house.line1.about: the Linesman explaining that the Woven Current hangs its camp between the walls on lines, with pods that part or join as the water needs

hemomancy.court.linesman.house.line2.about: the Linesman saying nobody ties you in but yourself, letting go is also your choice, and the camp keeps your place either way

hemomancy.court.linesman.item_hint.about: the Linesman offering to say what they know of whatever the player carries if they will show it

hemomancy.court.linesman.item_inquiry.mo.about: the Linesman explaining Dead Man's Rope feels the living through its strands and later ties the carrier to anyone who chooses to hold on
the Linesman telling the player to feed Dead Man's Rope in the camp after the Lightkeeper's lesson because the camp's water makes it grow faster

hemomancy.court.linesman.shunned.line1.about: the Linesman saying the player is scrubbed of every partner and a strand could carry that through the whole camp, so they cannot be tied in

hemomancy.court.linesman.shunned.line2.about: the Linesman asking the shunned player to keep off the lines, promising nobody will raise a hand to them

hemomancy.court.linesman.strain.other.about: the Linesman saying another house's strain is fine on the lines and the camp will not ask which if the player holds a strand

hemomancy.court.linesman.strain.own.about: the Linesman noting Dead Man's Rope in the player's veins and asking them, if they link with someone, to tell that person first that either can let go

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.food.line1.about: the Marrow-tender handing over food from the whale fall, saying it was strong once and is now the player's

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.greet.stra.about: the Marrow-tender greeting a stranger come down to the fall and warning them to mind the ribs, which are sharp where the flesh is gone

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.house.line.about: the Marrow-tender saying Last Marrow lives on a whale fall that is both food and shelter and will not last forever
the Marrow-tender saying nothing is wasted, and that when they are spent they will root in the bones and feed whoever comes next

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.item_hint.about: the Marrow-tender telling the player to show it, saying if it was once alive they will know what it is good for

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.item_inqui.about: the Marrow-tender identifying Marrowplume as their strain that feeds on the dead and heals the carrier with it, and later roots

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.rest.line1.about: the Marrow-tender telling the player to lie under the ribs out of the cold, promising to keep scavengers off

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.shunned.li.about: the Marrow-tender telling the player they are scrubbed of every partner, which down here would rot the whole fall
the Marrow-tender telling the shunned player to stay off the bones, promising nobody will hurt them but they cannot come in

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.strain.oth.about: the Marrow-tender saying another house's strain is fine because the fall feeds everyone the same

hemomancy.court.marrow_tender.strain.own.about: the Marrow-tender noting Marrowplume on the player's arms will feed them off whatever is left, and telling them to let it

the Nursery tender saying the Giving Light and Holding Stone are shoreward, the Woven Current's lines hang below in the twilight, and the young are not taken that deep

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.greet.str.about: the Nursery tender warning the newcomer to mind the cups with the young in them, and asking if they swam all this way alone

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.house.lin.about: the Nursery tender saying the Shared Wake's home is the school and this ground is where the young grow until they can keep pace

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.item_inqu.about: the Nursery tender explaining that Mermaid's Purse banks blood on the hunt and gives it to whoever in the school is hurt worst

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.earl.about: the Nursery tender saying they take no one before the fifth Degree, telling the player to grow into the blood first, and promising the school will still be swimming

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.join.stan.about: the Nursery tender saying the school barely knows the player yet, and telling them to bring the young a share of their catch, swim with them a while, then ask again

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.shunned.l.about: the Nursery tender saying the player is scrubbed of every partner and that could pass to the young, who have so little of their own yet
the Nursery tender asking the shunned player to keep away from the nursery and cups, promising nobody will hurt them but they cannot come near

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.strain.ot.about: the Nursery tender saying another house's strain is fine here because the young only care how gently you swim near them

hemomancy.court.nursery_tender.strain.ow.about: the Nursery tender noting Mermaid's Purse on the player's flank, which gives its banked blood to whoever in the school is hurt

hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.shunned..about: the Offering-bearer telling the player they carry nothing living and must stand back from the offerings

hemomancy.court.offering_bearer.strain.o.about: the Offering-bearer saying the player's strain belongs to another house and will not reach the heads, though they may still watch the feeding
the Offering-bearer noting Kinbud grows along the player's spine and that it is only the beginning of a lifetime of preparation

hemomancy.court.presence.marimo.chorus.about: a short title for the chorus of the anchored speaking together

hemomancy.court.presence.refused.site.about: a system message that the Court does not let this site be broken

hemomancy.court.refused.about: a system message that nothing is given, a bare refusal

hemomancy.court.rest.recent.about: a system message that the player rested here only a little while ago

hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.greet.stran.about: the Rooted elder greeting you who follow, glad to be awake for their arrival though unable to rise to meet them

hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.house.line2.about: the Rooted elder saying rooting is a choice they could still undo, but they would rather be of use here

hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.join.line1.about: the Rooted elder accepting you who follow into Last Marrow, and saying that when their strength is spent it will feed those who come after

hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.shunned.lin.about: the Rooted elder saying the player is scrubbed of every partner and in the bones that emptiness could spread to every elder rooted, so they cannot come near

hemomancy.court.rooted_elder.strain.own.about: the Rooted elder noting Marrowplume already on the player's arms, which at its fullest will let them root as the elder has, though roots can always be drawn out again

hemomancy.court.sleeper.strain.own.about: narration of a faint frost-blue pulse passing along the fold nearest the player, in time with their Hushbell

hemomancy.court.standing.raised.about: a system message that the player has risen to a new standing title in a named house (the standing's name and the house's name fill the blanks)

the Tidewarden describing the Woven Current's lines in the twilight, and saying they themselves do not go deeper because their post is here

hemomancy.court.tidewarden.house.line1.about: the Tidewarden explaining that the Holding Stone keeps the shelters and passages because someone always has to

hemomancy.court.tidewarden.strain.other.about: the Tidewarden saying the player's strain is another house's, which is fine because the refuge shelters everyone, and telling them to keep to the passage

hemomancy.court.tidewarden.strain.own.about: the Tidewarden noting Holdfast on the player's arms, a good grip, that will take the stone when they need it

hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.kn.about: the Veiled resident saying the player came alone and that the resident noticed

hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.me.about: the Veiled resident acknowledging one of the Fold and promising to ask nothing more

hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.re.about: the Veiled resident saying someone named this place to the player and asking who

hemomancy.court.veiled_resident.greet.st.about: the Veiled resident saying the player sees them, which few do, and asking why

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_bellwar.about: asking the Bellwarden whether they ever wish they could sleep too
the Bellwarden admitting they wish for sleep every night but someone must stay awake
the Bellwarden saying that when the bell wakes one to keep it they will sleep, because one awake keeper is enough
a short teaser that the Bellwarden has kept watch a long time and may say more once trusted
asking the Bellwarden whether the stores will last
the Bellwarden saying the stores last long enough if nobody wastes, that they count them each morning, and have never counted short
a short teaser that the Bellwarden counts everything and some counts are private

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_gardene.about: asking the Gardener which bed they planted first
the Gardener telling of the first bed by the steps with the crooked edge that they were so proud of they slept beside it, and offering the rest over a bowl
a short teaser that the Gardener loves to talk about the beds once the player has shared the table a while
asking the Gardener whether it hurts when visitors leave
the Gardener admitting it hurts every time: they feed visitors, their color returns, and they go up the water
the Gardener saying they know visitors must go and still set out one extra bowl for a while after, out of habit
a short teaser that something about leaving sits heavy with the Gardener

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_host.ow.about: asking the Host whether they have a room of their own here
the Host asking why they would tell a guest that, then wryly crediting the player for never asking their name
the Host admitting yes, behind the second screen, unseen, and asking if the player minds
a short teaser that even the Host keeps one door closed

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_host.th.about: asking the Host who painted the screen
the Host asking whether it matters whose hand painted it, saying many and a little their own, and that they will not ask whose ink the player brings either
a short teaser that the Host gives a room and not answers, not yet

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_linesma.about: asking the Linesman who tied their first line

a short teaser that the Linesman offers lines freely and the story of the first one less so
asking the Linesman whether they have ever let go of a line
the Linesman recounting letting go once when young, when the pod pulled somewhere they did not want to go
the Linesman saying they returned on their own later to find their place left open, and promising the player's will be open too if they ever let go
a short teaser telling the player to bring line for the camp a while if they want to hear what letting go is like

the Marrow-tender saying they have picked their spot near the third rib where the plumes grow thick
the Marrow-tender telling the player not to look like that, since it is a plan and they will still be of use
a short teaser that the Marrow-tender has already picked where to root
asking the Marrow-tender how long they have worked the fall
the Marrow-tender saying they have worked since the ribs were white, and that their hook is older than them and belonged to someone now rooted nearby
a short teaser that the Marrow-tender talks over the work and talks more if the fall is given something

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_nursery.about: asking the Nursery tender whether they were raised in these cups
the Nursery tender saying they were told they were raised in the cup by the big boulder, though they remember nothing

a short teaser to ask about the tender's own start once trust has grown
asking the Nursery tender how many young are in the cups now
the Nursery tender saying there are more young than last season counting the small one in the far cup, counted every time the school loops, and asking the player to help count the far side
a short teaser that the tender is busy but will make time to talk if the player helps the nursery

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_offerin.about: asking the Offering-bearer how long the walk down to the vents is
the Offering-bearer saying the walk is long enough to prepare on the way, that they carry the food, the heads take it, and they climb back
a short teaser that the Offering-bearer talks about the walk down only with people the Kindling know well
asking the Offering-bearer whether they hope to be worthy one day
the Offering-bearer admitting every bearer hopes to keep a head and that a lifetime of preparation is what it asks
the Offering-bearer saying they will not waste their lifetime and telling the player not to waste theirs
a short teaser that the Offering-bearer keeps a hope no visitor hears

hemomancy.dialogue.rapport.court_tidewar.about: asking the Tidewarden whether they have lost anyone in the passages
the Tidewarden saying they lost one person to the swell because they were late
the Tidewarden saying they have never been late since, test every way first, and promising to get the player through
a short teaser that the Tidewarden will say this once and only to someone trusted
asking the Tidewarden where their sounding pole came from
the Tidewarden saying the pole was the last warden's, found in the passage and kept as a promise to them
a short teaser that the Tidewarden keeps watch and not stories, not yet

a short title for the fish trade card
